label_validation: Raw proxies only; downstream label definition and validation are versioned separately

terrain.initial_state_jitter: xy +/-0.25m, yaw +/-0.1rad, joint position multiplier .95..1.05, joint velocity +/-0.1rad/s
terrain.note: 4096 robots share 84 tiles; independent collection seeds define separate geometry splits

force_order: oldest first; last 8 samples belong to the completed action interval
memory_note: Torch allocator excludes PhysX, Warp, Kit and driver allocations

schema.layout: time-major [step, env, ...]; global env indices are 0..num_envs-1
schema.input_time: policy_step * policy_dt, before the recorded action
schema.post_frame: completed interval's frame, terminal replaced with pre-reset final_obs
schema.history: current first + five past frames; reconstruct from pre_frame and episode_id; carry across shards
schema.detection: post_frame concatenated with pre_history[:225], no future measurements
schema.forecast: pre_history and optionally this action; not future actions
schema.terminal: keep complete terminal interval; never connect horizons across done
schema.increment_valid: false until enough pre-interval force samples exist in the episode
schema.force_semantics: world-frame net normal-contact resultant; not total including friction
schema.integral: normal-resultant magnitude integral, includes support loading; not isolated impact impulse
